info.title: PITON V5 domain API
info.description: One Web Request handler shared by local Node 24 SQLite and private Sites/D1. Authentication, ownership, XP ledger, drafts, projects and mastery are server-owned. Python grading authority is explicitly browser-preview in this P0 implementation. Full shared application types live in packages/contracts/index.ts; runtime protocol in packages/runtime/contracts.ts.

post.summary: Save a complete browser check and apply domain progression
post.description: P0 browser-preview evidence, not server Python grading. Validates canonical profile/core/variant, current content/assessment/runtime versions, check operation, complete exact unique test ID set, overall status/error and every passed/status. XP derives from curriculum once per profile+core, regardless of mode. Identical idempotent retries return duplicate:true and zero new XP; key/body conflicts or runId reuse fail with 409. Invalid evidence never creates an attempt. Valid failed checks create attempt/skill evidence without XP. Reflection/hints affect mastery only.
